content.title: THE MINERAL DEFICIENCY DOCTORS OFTEN MISS ON A CHECKUP
facts: **Copper** (Iron's Best Friend) — Shiitake Mushrooms | Cashews | Dark Turkey Meat | Sesame Seeds
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple | Pecans | Whole Oats
**Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Cod | Seaweed Snacks | Prunes | Eggs
**Potassium** (Blood Pressure Balancer) — White Beans | Coconut Water | Dried Apricots | Swiss Chard
**Selenium** (Cell Defender) — Sardines | Sunflower Seeds | Barley | Turkey
**Zinc** (Immune Gatekeeper) — Oysters | Pumpkin | Lentils | Hemp Seeds
**Calcium** (Nerve Signal Sender) — Sardines with Bones | Bok Choy | Almonds | Kefir
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Copper doesn't get much attention, but your body needs it to actually absorb and use the iron you eat — without enough copper, iron can sit there unused. Manganese quietly supports the enzymes that build and repair your bones and cartilage, so a shortage can show up as achy joints long before anyone thinks to check a mineral panel. And iodine is the one your thyroid literally cannot function without — too little and your metabolism can slow down even if everything else about your diet looks perfect. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and get labs checked if something feels off.
